name: Healing Touch, Greater
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level adept 5, bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 6, paladin 4, shaman 5, white necromancer 5, witch 5

This spell functions as lesser healing touch except that the amount healed is 1d8 + 1 per caster level (max +15).
